text:
alex kim: Morning team — I’ve claimed release-train slot on 2026-06-12 16:00 UTC (window 16:00–17:30). Need owners for three deploy lanes: web-api, inference-runtime, console. Reply with owner + smoke owner + rollback tag by EOD.
sam rodriguez: I can take web-api. Smoke owner: jen li. Target deploy ~16:10 UTC. Rollback tag: web-api@v1.42
jen li: Confirmed for smoke. I'll run the smoke script and check /health + p95 traces. If p95 > 500ms we roll. I'll post results here.
marta gonzalez: I'll own inference-runtime. Plan: 10% canary at 16:20, full at 16:30 if green. Smoke owner: me. Rollback tag: inference-runtime@2026-06-12-canary
oliver tucker: I’ll handle console. Smoke owner: sam (jen can back me up). Deploy target 16:40 UTC.
alex kim: Quick ops notes: set feature flag `rf:enable-new-routing` to OFF until smoke passes. Please mute non-critical alerts for the window and add a short alert suppression note. Ping @oncall if infra issues.
ci-bot: Pipeline update — web-api (PR#5321) queued, scheduled trigger 16:10 UTC. Status: pending.
sam rodriguez: Smoke checklist (short): 1) `./scripts/smoke.sh <service>` 2) curl health + check error rate 3) run `k metrics push --tag release=1890456789` for trace correlation.
jen li: Paste smoke command I’ll run:```bash
./scripts/smoke.sh web-api && curl -sS http://web-api.internal/health | jq .
```I'll post latency and error-rate summary in this thread.
alex kim: Rollback procedure (if needed): tag previous stable and run `./deploy/rollback.sh <service> --to <tag>`. If >=2 failed deploy attempts or infra errors, escalate to @oncall and call standby infra.
marta gonzalez: Noted. I’ll post canary metrics (error %, p95 latency, CPU) at +5m after canary.
oliver tucker: Who owns the post-deploy dashboard for console for first 30m? I can do first 15, then sam can take the next 15.
sam rodriguez: I’ll take the second 15m for console monitoring.
jen li: I’ll watch web-api for 30m post-deploy. Will thumbs-up if stable.
alex kim: Great — owners: web-api Sam (smoke Jen), inference Marta, console Oliver (handoff to Sam). If anyone needs to swap, update this thread and the deploy roster doc. React :warning: to flag a blocking issue. Thanks team!
